execution: unchanged causal per-token Bernoulli hard gates with previous-batch expected-budget threshold and gather/scatter
primary_metrics: scratch minus random sparse held-out loss at steps 50, 100, 150, and 200
scratch minus random sparse held-out accuracy at steps 50, 100, 150, and 200
interpolated sparse held-out loss at each arm's matched total FLOPs
scratch minus dense-fewer loss at dense-fewer total FLOPs
realized active fraction and corrected policy overhead
accounting: use max(executed router backward counter, analytical router backward estimate); include body, routing, router updates, and ordinary training; exclude held-out evaluation from cumulative training cost and report it separately

decision_rules.frontier_opening: scratch beats random at both lower budgets and reduces the matched-cost gap to dense-fewer relative to random at both budgets
decision_rules.development_level_3_signal: scratch beats cost-matched dense-fewer at both lower budgets while also beating random; requires fresh-body replication before any Level 3 claim
decision_rules.no_frontier_opening: do not tune these runs or call them confirmation; reassess before nonuniform or temporal budget allocation

prohibited: changing learning settings after seeing lower-budget results
claiming practical efficiency from fixed-budget wins over random alone
